title: Rory and the Silver Clover Knoll
verses:
The moon climbed above with a pale silver glow,
And lit up the hillside where quiet winds blow.
Now Rory walked softly to look at the hill,
Where petals of clover were sleepy and still.

Then Nia flew downward from high in the sky,
To watch as the shadows went whispering by.
And Ricky stopped running to yawn in the breeze,
Beside the tall branches of slumbering trees.

Now Benny knelt down like a pillow of moss,
Where ribbons of starlight were floating across.
And Tilly brought leaves from the edge of the dell,
To make a warm blanket where shadows soon fell.

Then Psittaco sang out a sleepy goodnight,
And tucked in his feathers so soft and so tight.
He nestled right down in the bundle of green,
The coziest cradle that ever was seen.

Now Rory curled down to be close to the rest,
And rested his chin on the rim of the nest.
His tail gave a swish as he started to doze,
Content from his head to the tips of his toes.

The stars in the heavens were sparkling deep,
To guide all the friends to a wonderful sleep.
The valley was quiet, the breezes were mild,
With sweet dreams for every dear dinosaur child.
